title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Minnat for 40 fasts 2221 views Q. My mom does niyath that if so and so thing happends she would observe one days fast.Now she has many fasts pending and as her health is not permitting she does it whenever she can slowly one by one.Is it possible to pay kaffarah for the fasts since she is not in good health to do that.What will be the kaffarah for one fast? 1976 views Q. Kaffarah will be wajib or not? 5309 views Q. Kya islaam mai mannat mangna haraam hai shirk hai? or kya baqra eid per nar baqre ki qurbani karna haraam hai jabki muje maloom hua hai ki haj ke duraan nar baqre ki hi qurbani di jati hai. 13413 views Q. One of my mom's friends is constantly making excessive minnats (for example, I will pray 200 salat-ut-tasbeeh, or finish the quran 50 times if such and such a thing happens). After the her duaa is accepted and the event happens she is unable to fulfill her minnat and almost forces my mom to help her fulfill it; for example, you read quran 40 times, I'll read it 10 times. Because the person is asking you to do a good deed you cannot refuse it, but it is also difficult to carry out the minnat within the period of time the friend gives. For this reason I was wondering if it is alright to tell the person to 1. not make such excessive minnats that you can't fulfill yourself 2. to pray or carry out the good deed before you make the duaa (since making minnat is sort of like playing with allah). Jazakallah Khair 2170 views Q. My wife before our marriage had made an niyath to keep nafl fast on monday and thursday after our nikah for the rest of her life. But due to some reasons she is not able to keep it regularly. Hence she skips it sometimes. I like to know is there is any alternative for the niyath she has made as per Islamic shariah. Kindly reply at the earliest because since missing of fast makes both of us feel guilty and we are not able to overcome that. 5341 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 65859 Country: INDIA Title: vows Question: I have taken an vows long day before, if I fulfill the vows dose I have to give any kaffarah for delaying that vows? Answer ID: 65859 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 845/846/SN=09/1437) If you have taken some common vow and have not limited it with time then merely there is no kaffarah due to the delay. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
